snippet.title: Artificial Detective | Official Extended Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
ARTIFICIAL DETECTIVE is a third-person action-adventure from artists behind Dead Space, Call of Duty, and Control, game designers from Crytek, and animators and storytellers from Love, Death & Robots and DreamWorks.

You play as a robodetective with fractured memories who wakes up in an empty dystopian world. Together with a robodog and a little human girl raised by machines, you fight zombie robots and figure out why humans are gone.

Wishlist on Steam TODAY: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2962320/Artificial_Detective/
